<?php
$login = $_POST['login'] ?? '';
$password = $_POST['password'] ?? '';

$cnx = mysqli_connect("127.0.0.1", "root", "", "bd_20252026");
$result = mysqli_query($cnx, "SELECT nom, prenom, password FROM Users WHERE login='$login'");
$user = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result);

if ($user && $password === $user['password']) {
    echo "Bonjour" . $user['nom'] . " " . $user['prenom'];
} else {
    echo "Login ou passwrd incorrect";
}

mysqli_close($cnx);
?>
